set.body:
## Objective and scope

Build an opt-in baseline whose data energy, physical deformation penalty, update/composition and line-search or trust acceptance describe the same operation.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Specify regularizer/state coordinates and derivatives in physical units. Account for support/reweighting with an explicit outer/inner policy and honest objective diagnostics.
2. Evaluate the complete candidate including regularization in acceptance. Candidate updates approach the current state as step tends to zero; preserve exact no-op/full-step and geometry semantics where promised.
3. Classify Gaussian operations as preconditioning, proximal regularization or explicit constraints and verify their mathematical role; do not merely add a penalty to a loss while omitting its update derivative.
4. Independent derivative/energy checks and affected JVM/Scala.js tests pass at synthetic and real checkpoints. Current defaults, prior evidence and composed-map admission stay unchanged until selection.

## Planned areas

- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/shared/src/main/scala/reframe4s/halfflow/HalfFlowCcEngine.scala
- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/shared/src/main/scala/reframe4s/halfflow/ForwardMidpoint.scala
- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/shared/src/test/scala/reframe4s/halfflow/

## Blocking prerequisites

- D03 (`bd-01M4X4DYHWY4N7QA8KRHFY3BQ1`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.

## References

- docs/benchmarks/real-image-development.md (2026-10-11 accumulated-smoothing and backtracking studies)
- docs/halfflow-capability-ledger.md
- Existing refinement issue bd-01M4NVC83PEY6F4GSGDRD6RFBH and full-boundary issue bd-01M2EG25H20DR7CXNHK22ZF4VE
- Same-affine reference: docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-calibration-20261011/reference-results.json
- SyN method: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2276735/
- Independent evaluation reference: https://github.com/JHU-MedImage-Reg/LUMIR_L2R
